bullets.id: Emas spot turun $81,70 atau 2,25% ke sekitar $3.552,50 pada Selasa menurut Kitco, dengan low harian $3.546, sehingga pantulan Senin terhapus. Aksi jual saham teknologi memaksa sebagian investor melepas emas dan perak untuk menutup margin call; perak anjlok 5,22% ke $40,79. Rabu pagi, Trading Economics mencatat emas masih di dekat $3.550.
bullets.en: Spot gold fell $81.70, or 2.25%, to about $3,552.50 on Tuesday according to Kitco, with a $3,546 daily low, erasing Monday’s bounce. A tech-stock selloff forced some investors to sell gold and silver to meet margin calls; silver sank 5.22% to $40.79. On Wednesday morning, Trading Economics shows gold still near $3,550.

bullets.id: Pasar memperkirakan sekitar 96% peluang kenaikan suku bunga Fed 25 bps pada Desember, dan sebagian juga memperkirakan kenaikan lagi pada Januari. Yield 10 tahun AS di dekat 4,90%, sementara minyak WTI naik 2,3% ke $82,05 di tengah gangguan Selat Hormuz. Emas turun sekitar 11,5% dalam sebulan dan sekitar 37% di bawah rekor $5.608 pada Januari.
bullets.en: Markets price about a 96% chance of a 25 bp Fed hike in December, and some also expect another hike in January. The US 10-year yield is near 4.90%, while WTI crude rose 2.3% to $82.05 amid disruption in the Strait of Hormuz. Gold is down about 11.5% on the month and about 37% below its $5,608 January record.

bullets.id: Kitco mencatat support di $3.520 lalu $3.500, dengan zona $3.380–$3.400 di bawahnya, sedangkan resistance di $3.630 lalu $3.650. Penentu berikutnya adalah data PCE Oktober, pesanan barang tahan lama dan revisi PDB kuartal III AS, Rabu pukul 08.30 ET (20.30 WIB); PCE headline diperkirakan sekitar 3,8% secara tahunan. Kamis pasar AS libur Thanksgiving.
bullets.en: Kitco lists support at $3,520 then $3,500, with a $3,380–$3,400 zone below, and resistance at $3,630 then $3,650. The next driver is October PCE, durable goods orders and revised US Q3 GDP, Wednesday at 8:30 a.m. ET (8:30 p.m. WIB); headline PCE is expected near 3.8% year on year. US markets close Thursday for Thanksgiving.

bullets.id: Antam 1 gram turun Rp8.000 ke Rp2.499.000, tetapi buyback anjlok Rp59.000 ke Rp2.091.000, sehingga spread melebar ke Rp408.000 (sekitar 16,3%). Galeri24 dijual Rp2.361.000 dengan buyback Rp2.220.000 (spread sekitar 6,0%). JPMorgan dan Commerzbank tetap memperkirakan emas pulih hingga akhir 2027, masing-masing ke $4.500 dan $4.100.
bullets.en: Antam’s 1-gram bar fell Rp8,000 to Rp2,499,000, but buyback dropped Rp59,000 to Rp2,091,000, widening the spread to Rp408,000 (about 16.3%). Galeri24 sells at Rp2,361,000 with a Rp2,220,000 buyback (a spread of about 6.0%). JPMorgan and Commerzbank still expect gold to recover by the end of 2027, to $4,500 and $4,100 respectively.
